meta.title: Analytics Engineer
meta.tagline: Build the data layer that powers organizational analytics.
meta.description: Analytics engineers sit between data engineering and data analysis — they build clean, tested, documented data models using tools like dbt. They ensure data quality, create reusable transformations and enable self-service analytics.
